messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water near San Jose Walmart. They want product info and stock status. We need to call the function with location "San Jose" and product list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. For pack_size, we have 12 cans of bottled water, so pack_size array should match product_list length. For apples and rice, no pack size needed; default is not used. So we can provide pack_size: [null, null, 12] or maybe just omit pack_size for those items? The function signature says pack_size?: number[], default not use if not specified. But we need to provide array of same length as product_list. So we can provide pack_size: [0, 0, 12] or maybe [null, null, 12]. The function expects number[]; null might not be acceptable. We can set pack_size: [1, 1, 12] but that would indicate pack sizes for apples and rice. But the user didn't specify pack sizes. The function says default is not use it if not specified. So we can just provide pack_size: [12] but that wouldn't match length. The spec says "The size of the array should be equal to product_list." So we must provide array of same length. But we can set pack_size: [0, 0, 12] meaning no pack size for first two. That might be acceptable. Let's do pack_size: [0, 0, 12].

We need to call the function.
